dimensional_analysis.A_SIGNED_BULGE_DENSITY: area-like; coefficient must compensate one length power relative to perimeter correction
dimensional_analysis.G_RUN_SWITCH_WEIGHTED_CHORD_DEFECT: length-like; coefficient is dimensionless if chord defect is raw length
dimensional_analysis.G_SIGNED_LOCAL_AREA_PER_EDGE: area-like; same dimensional role but different carrier area unit
dimensional_analysis.consequence: A/G raw run coefficients are not comparable even in principle without an explicit normalization map.

drift_diagnosis.reason: Frozen packet-local normalizations do not vary with teacher radius. Radius-dependent fitted coefficients therefore also reflect changing motif mixture, finite-radius boundary statistics, covariance/omitted-generator effects, or a genuine asymptotic trajectory.

A.coefficient_signs: bulge positive, run negative across requested scale refits
A.interpretation: sign stable; magnitudes non-smooth; coefficient limit not established; pair scale-robust through R640

G.coefficient_signs: area positive, run negative in every requested refit
G.interpretation: material radius/phase drift without sign flips; pair beats either single; larger radii recommended

future_dimensionless_proposal.purpose: make cross-carrier coefficient roles dimensionless and separate run topology from chord-defect amplitude
future_dimensionless_proposal.warning: This is a new future normalization/operator vocabulary, not a reinterpretation of frozen A/G coefficients.

next_action_recommendation: KEEP_FROZEN_OPERATORS_AND_CONTINUE_RADIUS_FOR_WITHIN_ARM_STABILITY; test the dimensionless vocabulary as a separately genealogized post-checkpoint generation before using coefficient magnitude as cross-arm evidence.
